story_description: Persist themes on disk and apply them through a central manager.
task_description: Custom themes need persistent storage with CRUD operations. Following the actor-based HookStore pattern ensures thread safety and consistent file I/O.
atom_description: Custom themes need persistent storage with CRUD operations. Following the actor-based HookStore pattern ensures thread safety and consistent file I/O.
problem_statement: Custom themes need persistent storage with CRUD operations. Following the actor-based HookStore pattern ensures thread safety and consistent file I/O.

functional_requirements: `loadThemes() async -> [ThemeProfile]` - Load all custom themes from disk
`saveTheme(_ theme: ThemeProfile) async throws` - Save/update a custom theme
`deleteTheme(id: UUID) async throws` - Delete a custom theme
Auto-create themes directory on first save
Store themes as JSON files under ~/Library/Application Support/Blaze/themes.
Use atomic writes and validate JSON before saving.
Load all themes on startup and skip invalid files with logs.
nonfunctional_requirements: File operations must not block UI
Support up to 100 custom themes without performance degradation
implementation_steps: Define as actor with fileManager dependency
Add error handling for permission/disk issues
api_contracts: `loadThemes()` - Returns array, empty if none exist
`saveTheme(_:)` - Creates or updates; throws on write failure
`deleteTheme(id:)` - Throws if theme not found or delete fails
